stories.desc: Intense laser light can make a crystal emit new colors at frequencies many times higher than that of the original beam. stories.title: How electrons find their way to diamond's quantum defects
stories.desc: A diamond's most useful quantum properties come from defects, places where the regular arrangement of carbon atoms is broken. One of these, a nitrogen atom situated next to a vacancy caused by a missing carbon atom, has become a key component in quantum technology.

stories.title: Quantum observers can 'agree to disagree,' but within limits, new theorem shows
stories.desc: Two observers can start with the same description of a quantum system, follow the same probability rules and still disagree about the chance of the same outcome—even while being certain of each other's assessments.
